mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT job.id FROM kb_embedding_job job WHERE job.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (job.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND job.retry_count < #{maxAttempts} AND job.next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (job.status IN ('PARSING', 'INDEXING') AND job.retry_count <= #{maxAttempts} AND job.lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY job.next_retry_at, job.created_at, job.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE kb_embedding_job job SET status = CASE job.job_type WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PARSE' THEN 'PARSING' WHEN 'DOCUMENT_INDEX' THEN 'INDEXING' ELSE job.status END, retry_count = job.retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now}, version = job.version + 1 FROM candidate WHERE job.id = candidate.id RETURNING job.*

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT job.id FROM kb_embedding_job job WHERE job.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND job.document_id = #{documentId} AND job.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY job.created_at DESC, job.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE ) UPDATE kb_embedding_job job SET status = 'CANCELLED', next_retry_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_by = #{operatorId}, cancel_trace_id = #{traceId}, cancelled_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = job.version + 1 FROM candidate WHERE job.id = candidate.id AND job.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND job.document_id = #{documentId} AND job.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'PARSING', 'INDEXING') AND job.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING job.*
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_embedding_job SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{now}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{jobId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
